arml-2015-superrelay-01.title: Pythagoras and similarity
arml-2015-superrelay-01.body:
$AR=\sqrt{5^2-3^2}=4$. In the similarity $T\leftrightarrow L$, $A\leftrightarrow M$, $R\leftrightarrow N$, side $MN$ corresponds to $AR$ and $ML$ to $AT$, so $ML=AT\cdot\frac{MN}{AR}=5\cdot\frac84=10$. Then $AR\cdot ML=40$.

**Answer: 40**

arml-2015-superrelay-02.title: Solve f(x)=x
arml-2015-superrelay-02.body:
*(In the Super Relay, $T$ was the answer to problem 1, which is 40.)*


$x=T(x-T+1)\iff x(T-1)=T(T-1)$. Since $T\ne1$, $x=T=40$. (Check: $f(40)=40\cdot1=40$.)

**Answer: 40**

arml-2015-superrelay-03.title: Percent
arml-2015-superrelay-03.body:
*(In the Super Relay, $T$ was the answer to problem 2, which is 40.)*


Marlys ate $40-24=16$ of $40$ strawberries, which is $\frac{16}{40}=40\%$.

**Answer: 40**

arml-2015-superrelay-04.title: Log rules
arml-2015-superrelay-04.body:
*(In the Super Relay, $T$ was the answer to problem 3, which is 40.)*


$\log K=\log1000-2\log\frac T8=\log\frac{1000\cdot64}{T^2}$, so $K=\frac{64000}{T^2}=\frac{64000}{1600}=40$.

**Answer: 40**

arml-2015-superrelay-05.title: Pythagorean Theorem
arml-2015-superrelay-05.body:
*(In the Super Relay, $T$ was the answer to problem 4, which is 40.)*


Let $R$ and $r$ be the radii of circles $J$ and $K$. The chord $XL$ is perpendicular to line $EJ$ at $O$, with $EO=2r$, so $JO=R-2r$ and
$$XO^2=R^2-(R-2r)^2=4Rr-4r^2.$$
Here $r^2=T=40$ and $Rr=4T-20=140$, so $XO^2=560-160=400$, $XO=20$, and $XL=40$.

**Answer: 40**

arml-2015-superrelay-05.title: Power of a point
arml-2015-superrelay-05.body:
Extend $EO$ to meet circle $J$ again at $D$; $ED$ is a diameter, so $OD=2R-2r$. By power of the point $O$: $XO\cdot OL=XO^2=EO\cdot OD=2r(2R-2r)=4Rr-4r^2=4\cdot140-4\cdot40=400$. So $XO=20$, $XL=40$.

**Answer: 40**

arml-2015-superrelay-06.title: Probability
arml-2015-superrelay-06.body:
*(In the Super Relay, $T$ was the answer to problem 5, which is 40.)*


$P(\text{purple})=\frac{15}{35+T}=\frac{15}{75}=\frac15=\frac8{40}$, so $K=40$.

**Answer: 40**

arml-2015-superrelay-07.title: Add the four new side faces
arml-2015-superrelay-07.body:
*(In the Super Relay, $T$ was the answer to problem 6, which is 40.)*


$K=2$, so the cubes have edges $\sqrt6$ and $1$. The large cube has surface area $6\cdot6=36$. Placing the small cube on top hides a $1\times1$ square of the large cube but adds the small cube's top (which exactly replaces it) and four side faces of area $1$ each. Total: $36+4=40$. (In general $18K+4(K-1)=22K-4$.)

**Answer: 40**

arml-2015-superrelay-08.title: Small search
arml-2015-superrelay-08.body:
*(In the Super Relay, $A_1$ and $A_2$ were the answers passed from problems 7 and 9, both 40.)*

$a_1=2$, $a_2=5$. The condition is $25+b_2^2=2(4+b_1^2)$, i.e. $2b_1^2-b_2^2=17$. Trying small values: $b_1=3$ gives $b_2^2=1$, $b_2=1$, with $b_1+b_2=4$. Smaller sums: $b_1+b_2\le3$ means $(b_1,b_2)\in\{(1,1),(1,2),(2,1)\}$, giving $2b_1^2-b_2^2=1,-2,7$ — none is $17$.

So $|z_2|^2=25+1=26$.

(Every other Super Relay answer that year was 40 — ARML's 40th contest, "Super Relay XL" — and $26_{17}=40_{10}$.)

**Answer: 26**

arml-2015-superrelay-09.title: Pascal's rule
arml-2015-superrelay-09.body:
*(In the Super Relay, $T$ was the answer to problem 10, which is 40.)*


$N=\binom{T+1}3-\binom T3=\binom T2=\frac{T(T-1)}2$, so $2N=T(T-1)$ and $T-1<\sqrt{T(T-1)}<T$. Hence $\lceil\sqrt{2N}\rceil=T=40$.

**Answer: 40**

arml-2015-superrelay-10.title: Cofunction identity
arml-2015-superrelay-10.body:
*(In the Super Relay, $T$ was the answer to problem 11, which is 40.)*


$\sin40^\circ=\cos50^\circ$, so $10+K=50$ gives $K=40$. Other solutions: $10+K\equiv\pm50\pmod{360}$, i.e. $K=40$ or $K=-60+360k$, $K=300,\dots$; the smallest positive is $40$.

**Answer: 40**

arml-2015-superrelay-11.title: Limiting ingredient
arml-2015-superrelay-11.body:
*(In the Super Relay, $T$ was the answer to problem 12, which is 40.)*


Alex has $5$ bags (enough for $5$ batches), Bailey $40$ cups of butter ($20$ batches), Casey $23$ cups of caramel ($7\frac23$ batches). The apples are the limiting ingredient: $5$ batches, giving $5\cdot8=40$ candied apples.

**Answer: 40**

arml-2015-superrelay-12.title: Tangent points lie on y = x
arml-2015-superrelay-12.body:
*(In the Super Relay, $T$ was the answer to problem 13, which is 40.)*


A tangent line of slope $-1$ is perpendicular to the radius, so the radius has slope $1$ and the tangent points lie on $y=x$ through the center: $(T\pm\frac T{\sqrt2},\,T\pm\frac T{\sqrt2})$. Then $x_1x_2=y_1y_2=T^2-\frac{T^2}2=\frac{T^2}2$, so $\frac{x_1x_2+y_1y_2}{T}=T=40$.

**Answer: 40**

arml-2015-superrelay-13.title: Fourth powers
arml-2015-superrelay-13.body:
*(In the Super Relay, $T$ was the answer to problem 14, which is 40.)*


Raise to the fourth power: $T^2=\frac{T^4}{20^4}(K+60)$, so $K=\frac{20^4}{T^2}-60=\frac{160000}{1600}-60=40$.

**Answer: 40**

arml-2015-superrelay-14.title: Union of intervals
arml-2015-superrelay-14.body:
*(In the Super Relay, $T$ was the answer to problem 15, which is 40.)*


The intervals are $[4,40]$ and $[0,17]$; they overlap, and the union is $[0,40]$, of length $40$.

**Answer: 40**
